Tags: **[S]** primary public source (verified 2026-10-16, see `claims_ledger.csv`), **[Y]** my synthesis.

## (a) Concept

| Term | Plain meaning | Anchor |
|---|---|---|
| Analytical performance | Does the assay measure the analyte correctly? (precision, bias, LoD, linearity, interference) | IVDR Art 2(40) [S] |
| Scientific validity (of an analyte) | Is the analyte associated with the condition? | IVDR Art 2(38) [S] |
| Clinical performance | Do results correlate with the clinical condition in the target population? (sens, spec, PPV, NPV, LR) | IVDR Art 2(41) [S] |
| Clinical validity | Same idea in non-IVDR language: does the marker discriminate the condition | [Y] |
| Clinical utility | Does using the test improve decisions or outcomes? IVDR defines no such term | [Y] |
| IVD | Device for in-vitro examination of specimens | – |
| Companion diagnostic (CDx) | Device "essential for the safe and effective use of a corresponding medicinal product" to select patients | IVDR Art 2(7) [S]; FDA 2014 guidance [S] |

The IVDR defines scientific validity *of an analyte*, not of a device.

## (b) Regulatory anchor

### EU: IVDR 2017/746 (original OJ text read; consolidated text not verified)

| Provision | What it is | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Art 47 | Classification of devices (A–D) | **Not** safety requirements |
| Art 48 | Conformity assessment procedures | CDx consultation at 48(3)/(4) class D, **48(7)/(8) class C** |
| Art 56 | Performance evaluation and clinical evidence | three pillars in 56(3); clinical performance studies unless justified (56(4)); class C/D report updated at least annually (56(6)) |
| Art 57 | General requirements for performance studies | |
| Art 58 | Additional requirements (interventional/invasive); **58(2) CDx studies included** | left-over-sample CDx studies are only notified |
| Annex I | GSPR; 9.1(a) analytical parameters, 9.1(b) clinical parameters | the list your statistics must cover |
| Annex VIII | Classification rules; **Rule 3(f) = CDx, class C** | Rule 1 D, 2 C/D, 3 C, 4 C, 5 A, 6 B, 7 B |
| Annex XIII Part A | Performance evaluation plan (PEP), report (PER), clinical performance study plan 2.3.2 | PEP includes statistical tools and acceptance criteria |
| Annex XIII Part B | Post-market performance follow-up (PMPF) | |

Consultee for CDx: "a competent authority … under Directive 2001/83/EC or the EMA, as applicable" [S].

**Transition** (Reg (EU) 2024/1860): legacy certificates to 31 Dec 2027; first-time NB devices D 2027, C 2028, B/sterile A 2029 with conditions. COM(2025) 1023 is a *proposal* [S, status unverified].

### Guidance

| Document | Facts |
|---|---|
| MDCG 2022-2 (Jan 2022) | General principles of clinical evidence for IVDs; sections on performance evaluation plan/report, scientific validity, analytical and clinical performance, PMPF |
| ISO 20916:2019 | Good study practice for clinical performance studies using specimens from human subjects; analytical studies out of scope |
| STARD 2015 | 30 items (BMJ 2015;351:h5527) |
| QUADAS-2 | 4 domains: patient selection, index test, reference standard, flow and timing |
| ICH E9 (1998), E9(R1) (2019) | Drug-trial guidelines; used here **by analogy** [Y] |

### US pathways

| Route | Meaning | Verb |
|---|---|---|
| 510(k) | substantial equivalence to a predicate | cleared |
| De Novo | no predicate, low/moderate risk | granted |
| PMA | class III, scientific review | approved |

The verb mapping is a synthesis [Y]; FDA has no single defining sentence. The Elecsys Phospho-Tau (217P) Plasma test was cleared via 510(k) K261686 (Day 6).
